title: Provision a User Account (with optional SSH key)
description: Creates or updates a Linux user account, optionally adding it to a group and installing an SSH public key into authorized_keys -- the repetitive part of onboarding a new cluster user by hand, fanned out across your inventory.

variables.name: PRIMARY_GROUP
variables.prompt: Group to add the user to (leave empty for none)

variables.name: SSH_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.prompt: SSH public key to install (paste the full line, or leave empty to skip)

toggles.name: DISABLE_PASSWORD_LOGIN
toggles.prompt: Disable password login for this account (SSH key only)
